data.raw_text:
WATCH: This aerial footage, taken late Saturday afternoon, August 30, shows the extent of flooding across parts of Quezon City following intense rainfall.

According to the local government, the city recorded 121 millimeters of rain in just one hour, affecting 36 out of 142 barangays. This figure exceeds the 90 millimeters per hour recorded during Tropical Storm Ondoy in 2009.

"Sa preliminary analysis ng UP Resilience Institute at UP NOAH Center batay sa rain gauges at weather stations sa Metro Manila ng PAGASA at IRISEUP ng QC government, mailalarawan bilang 'phenomenal' o pambihira ang pag-ulan kanina na ang pinakabulto ay naitala sa Quezon City at Nangka, Marikina," the statement reads. | 🎥: Mark Gil San Jose

READ RELATED STORY: https://t.co/TwmCWv67KO
